style_prefix: cozy pixel-art game asset, 3/4 top-down view with a slight isometric tilt (camera about 35 degrees above the horizon, front face and top surface both visible, top:front ratio about 2:1), simple rounded shapes, thick dark-brown outline (#3A2C24), soft warm pastel palette, flat two-tone shading with light from the top-left, tiny highlights, no gradients, no text, no letters, no watermark, single isolated object centered with generous margin, consistent scale where one floor tile is 32 px, crisp pixels, no anti-aliasing blur
tile_prefix: seamless tileable pixel-art texture, straight top-down orthographic view, no perspective, no outline on the tile border, soft warm pastel palette, subtle two-tone pattern, no text, exact square, the texture fills the entire canvas edge to edge and repeats without visible seams
wall_prefix: cozy pixel-art game asset, interior wall segment seen straight from the front (the wall stands vertically, we see its face and the top edge as a thin lighter strip), thick dark-brown outline (#3A2C24), soft warm pastel palette, flat two-tone shading, no gradients, no text, tileable horizontally (left and right edges continue seamlessly), the segment fills the canvas width
char_rules: chibi proportions, head about 40% of the total height, standing on a one-tile footprint, simple dot eyes, small smile, thick dark-brown outline, flat colors, transparent-looking plain background, the character centered with margin, full body visible including feet
ref_hint: Match EXACTLY the art style, outline thickness, camera tilt, level of detail and palette of the reference image(s); the new object must look like it belongs to the same set.
bg_hint: The entire background is one flat solid color {BG} covering the whole canvas, nothing else in the frame, no shadow or gradient on the background, the object never touches the canvas edges.
avoid: Avoid: photorealism, 3D render, blur, soft focus, strong perspective, vanishing point, gradients, background shadow, text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, cropping, multiple objects, extra limbs.
